theory: Qualify the two blanket bias statements: changing the tagged fraction changes the estimate when the first-stage marked count is fixed, but 'too high' or 'too low' requires a specified target population and a biased fraction relative to that population. Births or untagged immigration can increase the actual population without causing overestimation of the recapture-time population; also state that zero marked recaptures give no finite estimate using this formula.
